balls.text: more chaos - Starc sent down a short of length and slow ball outside off, Faf waited and scooped it in the air behind square. Third man cuts it off and throws it quickly but it's an overthrow, and Nehra forces Faf to come back for the third as he ways way back in the crease after the second

two run outs missed on the same ball! Nehra tried to guide the full ball with a horizontal ball on off, missed and ran and so did Faf. first DK missed the stumps and then Starc missed them at the non-striker's end
rams into the off stump at 145kmh! Angled it in from outside off, Mohit made room and swing his arms but the ball rammed into the off stump
lands it short outside off and takes the pace off, surprises Mohit who tries to scoop it to off but misses
quick and pitched up just outside off, Mohit drives and misses again
full and across outside off, Mohit charges, swings and misses
too full on the stumps, Faf picks it up and slams it high and straight down the ground over long on for six
back of length and angling in, slapped over Faf's head for one to long on
too slow at 112kph, it's short and wide too, but Faf has come across and he guides towards point for one
full and a bit outside off, driven towards sweeper cover for one
makes room for the slower ball on the stumps, it's absolutely full and Ashwin slice it straight to short third man
he comes down, Wiese sends it down the leg side for a wide
too slow and short outside off, it's wide too and Ashwin has all the time in the world to cut it betwen short third man and point for four
takes it on the full and hammers it down the ground, between Ashwin's legs to beat long on with that powerful shot
slower on off, pushed down to long on for one more
angled in towards middle and leg now, whipped to deep midwicket and they want two but Faf slips while turning back for the second
flatter and wider outside off, goes for a wide

you can give them to AB and he'll catch them. Pitched up around off, it was slow again, and Bravo looked to loft it over the covers but mistimed it straight down the ground, high in the air. AB comes from long on and catches it safely
slower through the air around off, Bravo waits and defends it back
comes down the track and drives the low full toss to long on for one
angles in another low full toss, Bravo flicks it off the pads right in the gap that's between deep square leg and fine leg
full again and he drives it down to long on for one
knee-high full toss and some room, Faf puts his back foot towards off stump, opens up and slices it over  point for four
attempted yorker is a low full toss on the stumps, pushed off the back foot on off for one
just short of sweeper cover, he lofted the fullish delivery from outside off in the air with a drive for one
short of length from outside off, he's hardly bowled those, Faf nudges it fine on the leg side off the ribs and collects four by beating fine leg
charges down now and swings his arms for a single to long off
too short on off, he gets the time to go back and pull it between long on and deep midwicket for four
comes down now and drives the length delivery into the covers
just outside off, pushed to point off the back foot
in the arc, but not out of the park even though it looked like he middled it. Fulish around off, lofted between long on and deep midwicket, but it's gone high enough for long on to get under it
some turn outside off, pushed into the covers for one
makes some room for the ball that comes in, pushes to cover and that's very quick running from Jadeja even as Kohli gets an accurate throw. Direct hit would have made it close, though
inside edge for the ball that turned towards off from middle, Faf tried to whip against the turn but could not middle
goes on the back foot for the shortish ball outside off, whips it towards mid on but Chahal runs across to deny the single
goes back again for the similar delivery and whips it this time to deep midwicket
length delivery around off, Jadeja goes back and pushes it down to the bowler
Dhoni mistimes, Dhoni is gone! He came outside the crease, couldn't take it on the full and lofted it outside off, didn't middle it at all and found sweeper cover
quick bouncer over the stumps, Jadeja decides to leave this one
back of length just outside off, punched wide of point for one
short again, this time it's pulled along the ground to deep midwicket for one
short, pulled, four! That was too short on the leg side, he got enough time to get on top of that and pull it wide of deep midwicket for four
tries to tuck the ball off the legs, but takes it on the pads as he can't time it well
length delivery towards the pads, Jadeja tucks it to the leg side in the gap and they take two by the time deep square leg gets there
turning away from length outside off, Dhoni pushes it off the back foot to point
can't clear the fielder this time, holes out to long off! He charged down, as usual, chipped the ball down the ground with power, but it didn't have enough to clear Rossouw at long off
that's not full either, but he unleashes the slog-sweep, doesn't middle it and clears the short boundary at deep midwicket. Top edge for six
this isn't too full, isn't too short but he has stayed back in the crease and has lofted it off the back foot over deep midwicket. Very well executed for six
has he middled that? Doesn't matter...it's six! Comes down again to the spinner, takes it as half volley and tonks it straight over long on for one more six
pitched up on middle and leg, Dhoni drives it down to long on but doesn't time it too well
too full on the pads and it's driven slightly wide of long on, Dhoni runs like his usual fast self and is safe for the second
can't hold him back for too long when he's coming down! Gets to the pitch of the ball just outside leg and slams it to the wide long-on boundary again with lofted drive with a flamingo aerial flick
much shorter but closer to off, Dhoni goes back and whip-slaps it to deep midwicket for one
bit too short and wide outside off, it turns away for a wide
takes a step down again, Raina chips it straight down the ground to long off
charges down and Iqbal yorks him, Raina blocks it back
too wide outside off, Raina swings his arms for the shortish delivery and sends that one past point for a powerful four
full and just outside off, driven down to long off for one
incoming delivery towards middle stump, steered towards midwicket for one
another slower one, it's short of length outside off, Dhoni dances down and slashes at it with some power to beat sweeper cover, who hardly has time to react
slower and fuller offcutter outside off, sliced to third man for one
chance for a run out! Dhoni took a step down and flicked the ball to short fine leg, Harshal picked it early, aimed for the stumps at the keeper's end but Raina dived in and it was not a direct hit
fullish on the off stump, Raina drives it over the bowler's head to long on for one
tries to paddle the ball from middle and off, misses and there's no time for leg bye
presses forward now and drives the length delivery to cover with the turn
turning away from outside off, Dhoni waits and guides it to point
stays back and pushes the ball from outside off to cover
slightly slower on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for one
charges down and absolutely bludgeons that with a swing to the leg side, sends it very deep in the stands over the wide long on boundary. Massive six
bit too full outside off, and...wait for it, Dhoni has driven it with a flick of the wrists to manoeuvre it past point for a four. Such an unusual shot in general, but nothing unusual for Dhoni
edged and gone! This was touch back of length outside off, Smith poked trying to steer it to third man but found a thick outside edge and DK pouches it with both hands to his right
139kph, bouncer this time towards leg, Smith ducks under it
makes room by clearing the front foot and punches the ball from middle stump to the right of mid off
short outside off now, he pulls and finds deep backward square leg with a bottom edge
fullish on the pads, Smith glances it fine enough and beats a diving fine-leg fielder - Wiese - to get four more. The time out hasn't affected him
slow and cutting in from short of length, Smith stays back and turns it to leg for one
short and slow delivery now, Smith ducks under it to leave it for the keeper
slow, full, well outside off and Smith drives it through the covers. Four more even though it was not from the middle of the bat, but was in the gap
full delivery followed by short ball, Smith rocks back and Smith smashes it to the midwicket boundary for another six with a pull
too full this time, it's in Smith's zone and he hammers it down the ground from outside off for a massive six!
beautiful sow offcutter from Wiese, it comes in, beats Smith and goes just over the stumps
bouncer for Raina - he pulls and misses and DK dives for the ball to stop it with one hand
slower ball at 116kph on middle and leg, Smith waits and chips it in the air to fine leg for one
another inside edge onto the pads as Smith tries to push the incoming delivery to the leg side
loud appeal for lbw from Harshal with a delivery that came in, but the ball took an inside edge before hitting the pads
full on the leg stump, tucked away easily to fine leg for one
down the leg side, but it comes in and goes over leg stump as Raina shuffles across to glance but misses
coming in towards the middle stump, Smith defends on the leg side
lbw appeal for the ball that pitched outside leg, Raina takes a leg bye
elegant drive straight down the ground for six! Pitched up on the stumps, Raina plomps his right foot forward and tonks it into the sight screen
slow again, at 114kph, Raina waits for this one outside off and finds point
slower one at 113kph on the leg stump, pushed down to mid on
outside off with the angle and some room, Raina cuts it straight to cover point
another lbw appeal turned down as Raina pulled the back of length delivery and missed, the ball went off the thigh pad to third man
length delivery towards middle stump, Raina pushes it into the covers
full again, it's a slower delivery and Raina pounces on it with a lofted drive over the covers for another four
driven for four now! Pitched up, Raina saw room and drove it square slightly late to beat point for a four along the ground
stifled appeal as Harshal traps Raina with a back of length ball from outside off, but it looked high. Was struck in front of off stump, though
tries to drive the first ball from outside off and misses
pulled for six! It was too short now, was slow too, Smith went back to the back foot and slammed it for a clean six
errs towards leg stump now and Smith sweeps it to short fine leg
slightly slow and full around off, pushed to mid off from the front foot
on length on middle, Raina goes back and tucks the ball down to long on
towards middle and leg now, fullish again, and he half-slogs it off the edge to deep midwicket

thick outside edge, lands right in between short third man and point and it goes for four! The ball was turning away, Smith drove, but not for the turn, and the ball was in the air before landing safe

beautiful delivery, extra bounce! Pitched it up outside off, there was pace, Raina's bat for the drive came down a bit late, the ball then swung away and bounced almost till DK's chest with the bounce
almost in the block hole well outside off, steered to third man for one
slightly closer to the off stump, angling away again, and Smith leaves at the last minute now
swing and a miss! Length delivery going away from Smith, he chases with a drive and misses
low full toss outside off, Smith pushes it to point. He hasn't been going for the big drives
outside off with the angle and it's left alone

charges down first ball, it's a top edge, won't go for a six, but he's safe. It didn't go off the middle as Raina tried to take it on the full, went for a big drive down the ground and the ball fell just inside the rope even as AB came from somewhere to cut it off, but could not

cuts it to point, Baz is gone in the second over! Chahal delivered this one slower outside off, it turned the other way and Baz went back in the crease to cut it off the middle. Rossouw takes a good, low catch towards his left there
defends the length delivery back to the bowler, didn't time it properly
bit of turn outside off from length, Baz pushes at it without footwork and misses
much straighter on the middle stump, steered down to long on off the back foot
towards the pads from length, tucked towards short fine leg for two
pitched up, there's room too and Baz lofts it effortlessly over the point boundary for a one-bounce four
that's a yorker on off with inswing, Baz drives with an outside edge to point
towards the pads and McCullum glances, the ball goes off the thigh pad and just beats DK behind the stumps to race away for four
third full toss, Smith drives again and it goes to third man where the fielder dives to his left to save three runs
wider and slightly higher full toss, Smith pushes at it tentatively and edges to second slip after a bounce
right on target - inswinging and on middle stump, almost a yorker as it's a low full toss and Smith blocks it back
a wicket on the last ball as Wiese threw his bat at this one outside off, get a leading edge and Smith ran in from deep cover to take the catch
that's gone like a rocket between point and short third man for four. He got room outside off, stayed back and hammered it behind square for four
swing and a miss for the widish delivery outside off, goes to the keeper
lands it in the block hole outside off as Starc shuffles across and whips it to deep midwicket
back of length outside off, he slams it to off but gets an edge to cover
short ball angled in, pulled down to long on for one
nth slower ball off the innings, outside off and Wiese slams this one high and far in the air over the wide long on boundary for a big six. Wiese's efforts proving futile again
short and angled in, pulled away to wide long on for one
rolls his fingers over it again towards middle and leg, Wiese gets some bat for one on the leg side
cuts it in with slower ball at 106kmh, Wiese went back to whip it to off, but was beaten and took it on his groin
slightly back of length towards off stump, steered down to long on for one
bangs it in short and angles it in, Starc gets under that and hooks it over and wide of short fine leg for four
the nth inside edhe of the innings as Starc looks to slam this on leg but gets a single on off behind square
fullish outside off, lofted down to long on after a bounce
stifled appeal for lbw as Wiese misses his slog, gets hit on the pad and the ball deflects past Nehra at short third man for four leg byes
finally connects as he slaps this short of length delivery down the ground towards long off for four
at 132kph now, Wiese heaves the straighter delivery on the leg side but misses
no pace on that one, not much bounce either outside off, he cuts and finds an inside edge
fullish on off stump, driven down to long off for one
pitches it wider outside off, Wiese drives by swinging his arms but only gets an inside edge onto his pads
slower one now at 117.5kph outside off, he angled it across again, Wiese looked to cut and missed it
angled across from length outside off, Wiese pokes and misses

another one falls, another nail hammered by Nehra! Harshal pulls his first ball, it was a short one, but manages only a top edge down the ground. It's gone high enough for Bravo to run behind the umpire form mid off, he catches it and does a little Calypso jig

he is back and gets a wicket immediately, the big one! Landed a full delivery on the pads, Kohli launched it high on the leg side with a flick, Smith was there right at the midwicket boundary at the edge and caught it over his head on the right side. Very well judged
fullish outside off, Kohli came down a bit and drove it to deep cover in the gap
angled in towards the stumps, Kohli tonks it straight down the ground into the sight screen. That went quick and flat over the umpire's head
shorter outside off, he cuts off the back foot towards deep point
comes down the track to take it as a low full toss and drives it to sweeper cover
fullish on middle and leg now, Kohli steers it through the midwicket region off the front foot with soft hands to get two
full outside off, struck powerfully down to long off
gets width again and he beats sweeper cover again! It was outside off, e freed his arms with a swish and it went right off the middle of the bat. Beat everyone for four!
slower offcutter outside off, he nudges it towards point for a quick one
right in the block hole on middle stump, gets a thick outside edge behind square on off
gets room and slaps it through the covers with the wrists, completing a swiveling motion and that beats sweeper cover
inside edge again as Kohli heaves the length delivery from around off but hits his own pads
too full on the stumps, Kohli rams it straight down the ground and Baz runs to his left and throws the ball up for long off. Can the ball ever escape him?
driven with some power through the off side to sweeper cover for one, he keeps strike
fullish outside off, driven straight to point
goes on the back foot and punches it into the covers for one
right from the middle of the bat, but he finds deep midwicket. Went down on a knee for the ball outside off, swept it against the turn and holed out to Mohit, who was a good few yards inside the rope
clips the ball from off stump to the leg side in the gap and calls for two early, Kohli responds and they get two
makes room towards leg and executes a good-looking inside out drive over the covers for a big six. That's why Sarfaraz is in the team. Beautifully struck
another bottom edge as Kohli drives the length ball outside off, but can't clear the bowler
straight on middle stump, driven towards midwicket as Raina dives to his left and saves one
shuffles across towards off and glances the ball to fine leg for one
steers the ball from around off to midwicket for a quick single
he drives with some power but the ball gets the inside edge and nearly hits the stumps
defends the length delivery outside off just past Dhoni with an edge, gets one
beaten by turn, Dhoni asks for stumping but umpire says no! He pitched it up outside off, Kohli drove and missed the ball as it turned away, Dhoni whipped the bails off too, but Kohli was in
wider outside off and he cuts it for one towards square
tries to paddle the ball from outside off to leg but misses

run out chance, it's Dhoni's smart work again despite a wide throw, the decision goes upstairs! Replays show AB is out despite his dive, out by a couple of inches. Kohli punched at the ball towards sweeper cover, initially they might have thought of two and AB turned around quickly, so did Kohli but said no after a couple of steps. The throw at keeper's end was wide, Dhoni came out of the crease and parried the ball to the stumps
tries the backfoot cut again and misses this time
flattish outside off, Kohli cuts off the back foot to point where Pandey dives and stops it
that's too full, there's enough room too and AB swings his bat with a big follow through straight over long off for a massive six
slightly slower on the stumps, flicked in the air, wide of midwicket and down to long on
low and out-swinging full toss, driven down to long on for one
pretty wide outside off and short of length, he swings and misses
in the block hole on the stumps, he digs it out towards mid on
length delivery outside off, punched down to long off
cracking shot! Reached out for the length delivery outside off, swept it a long way against the turn and as soon as he hit it, the ball had no choice but to go for six over deep midwicket
straighter on middle stump, Kohli stays back and punches to long on
stays back this time and whips the ball off the back foot to leg
darts this one in, AB defends it back but the inside edge hits the pads and just misses the off stump
touch wider outside off, pushed down to long off
just outside off, Kohli makes room and cuts it to short third man where Nehra bends but lets it through his legs for four. Blunder!
stifled appeal for lbw as it's going down leg. He took a step down and took the ball full on the pads in front of leg as he missed the flick
lands it short and outside off now, AB slaps it down to cover again
slightly full outside off, he drives it straight to cover
cutting in now, pushed down the ground for one

that's a spectacular catch from Bravo, and what a celebration! Back of length slower ball towards off stump, DK lofted it down the ground, it didn't go that high but Bravo ran in from long on and threw himself forward to get his fingers under it. Then he gets up, raises his right hand and leg simultaneously, then the left ones for a little jig. All in slow motion
outside the off stump, DK guides the ball to point
turning in now and Kohli helps it with the turn to midwicket
another boundary, Kohli gets room outside off and drives it handsomely and powerfully past cover and long off for four
quick, short and wide carrom ball way outside off for a wide
flat and short on middle, Kohli picks it early and hammers it with some elegance to the midwicket boundary for a clean six
fullish outside off now, DK leans forward and drives it to deep point
shorter and turning down leg, DK moves to off and goes down on a knee to sweep it wide of short fine leg for four behind square
length delivery turning towards off and middle, slammed down the ground in the air to long on for one
offcutter towards middle and leg, clipped past midwicket for one
back of length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for one
outside off now, defended with soft hands behind square for one

right on target on the off stump, DK defends it close to the off stump and Kohli responds for the quick single eve  as Dhoni comes down and kicks the ball but misses the stumps. What's the use of all those football practice before a cricket match?
bit too short, DK rocks back and pulls it between deep midwicket and long on in the gap for two
back of length and cutting in towards off, crams DK for room and he defends it back
thick edge off the delivery angling away from outside off, DK pushed at it and found a single to third man
touch fuller towards the off stump, he defends towards the covers with soft hands and sets off for a quick single
similar length and closer to off, Kohli defends to leg this time
just back of length now outside off, Kohli defends it to point
fullish around off, pushed down to mid-off off the front foot
swinging in a bit from middle stump, flicked away to deep square leg for one
solid defence from DK this time, but they need less of that and more of his big hitting
superb outswinger! Pitches on a length and jags away with beautiful shape. DK is nowhere near it
slower delivery on the pads, Kohli finds it easy to whip it away to long leg
beats the inside edge! This was length delivery just outside off and Kohli looks to punch it firmly, but just passes under the bat. Good take by Dhoni
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman looks to pierce the off side with his cut, but finds man at point
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it to the leg side

Ashish!!!! He has two in this over. This one slides under the bat and hits the stumps. To be fair to Rossouw, this was the work of the pitch. It stayed very low after bouncing on a length. But Nehra will take it. His wickets tally keeps going up
comes down the pitch and carves this through backward point
length delivery, the batsman punches it through midwicket

Faf du Plessis, you beaut!!! He keeps taking this shoulder-breaking catches in almost every game. This is a top-edge as Bisla looks to hit down the ground and it looks like well clear of mid-off, but Faf back pedals and somehow gets under it just in time.. Falls backwards hard on that right shoulder. Just saw on the replay.. this is a one-hander.. doubly impressive then
this time he doesn't swing it! This one keeps going away with the angle and beats the outside edge
he continues to impress with his lines. This is tight on off stump and Bisla can only defend it to point
smart adjustment there! He is already doing better than Gayle till now. Comes down the pitch, gets a slower bouncer, has to adjust a bit but then hammers it over mid-on
bowls a slower delivery wide outside off, Rossouw lets it go through
that is awesome! This is very very long. If there were no stands, this might have gone all the way to Chennai. He charges down the pitch and makes a clean connection to send it flying over long on
waits in the crease and pulls this back of length delivery over midwicket with ease. The bounce is ideal for such shots here

McCullum is crazy! There is no other word for it. Bisla charges out, has to reach out as this is slightly wide, slices it over cover and it looks set for a boundary.. but McCullum dives like a mad man and pulls it back. Reminds me of the dive he put in during the game against Bangladesh.. got Mike Hesson worried
that's a smart little pull shot again! A copy of the one he played in the first over. It's not really short but he gets in great position, then whacks it over midwicket
stands upright and punches the back of length delivery towards cover, but can't find the gap
comes down the pitch and mistimes a pull towards mid-on
charges down the pitch and looks to hoick it towards leg side but gets hit on the pad again. Nehra's swing is doing the trick. But they take a leg bye towards point
back of length on the leg stump line, the batsman pulls it down to long leg
full and swinging in towards the stumps, Bisla doesn't commit to the front foot and pushes it with soft hands towards mid-on
he looks to work the length delivery away to the leg side but gets hit on the thigh pad.. They take a single off the ricochet towards point
stays on the back foot and punches the back of length delivery to mid-off

looked like he was giving some catching practice to the man at cover, but fortunately for him, this one is in the gap. And they say in Bangalore that once it's past the inner circle, it's also past the outer circle
slower delivery! Bisla is completely foxed by it, but he was never looking to hit that out of the ground. He pushes it in the air towards mid-on. All safe and sound
he walks down the pitch but this one swings away from back of length and beats the outside edge
he is quick to pounce on this short one from Ishwar! Easily hammers it over midwicket
nice little outswinger, Bisla plays it calmly towards point
